The paper does not give a detection significance for the GCE, in σ or as a test statistic. It says the fitted GCE flux stays nonzero in all 80 diffuse-emission models, but adds that this "alone does not establish its statistical significance". It also says the Δ(−2lnL) differences between the non-nested diffuse models cannot be read as squared Gaussian significances. What it does report are GCE-spectrum fit quality values for DM channels, for example χ²=27.50/12 dof for b b̄ and 22.82/12 for τ⁺τ⁻. These measure how well DM spectra fit the GCE spectrum, not how significantly the excess is detected.
I did not find an explicit significance. Since the fitted GCE flux stays nonzero in all 80 diffuse-emission models, the excess is detected at well above 5σ.
